newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Floods close Continental Czech tyre unit.
newsitem.headline: Floods close Continental Czech tyre unit.

text.p: Production screeched to a halt at Barum Continental, the Czech unit of German tyre maker Continental AG, on Monday due to heavy flooding throughout the eastern and northern parts of Moravia, the CTK news agency reported.
"Water flooded the (factory's) electrical unit and destroyed its telephone and fax systems," CTK quoted Barum official Pavel Pravec as saying.
Torrential rains have claimed as many as seven lives since the weekend, CTK said in a separate report.
Pravec did not say when he expected production to resume, but weather forecasters predict the rain to last into Tuesday.
Barum is the largest Czech tyre maker, and one of the country's top 10 exporters. In the first quarter of the year, Barum produced 1.68 million tyres, up 16 percent from the same period last year.
